producer_report.summary: Root cause: \"Athena knows X\" is ambiguous between documentation for readers and behavior built into the agents, and the reader prompt never made the reader decide which or list the rules that bound the affected role. I fixed it in the reader prompt, not in jobs 20261109-080749-p0fs or 20261109-080220-zkhy. I added one bullet to 'Reading the request' in reader.md. It makes the reader say docs or agent behavior, name the roles and prompts that change, list the bounding rules (ladder rungs, budgets, role limits, admission), and make blocking non-owner-only rules deliverables. To fit the budget I dropped the filler 'Users write lazily.' and shortened the next bullet. The reader set is now 1998 of 2000 tokens, and I updated that figure in docs/system-facts.md. A new unit test checks every element of the rule in the composed reader prompt's reading section, and one FRAME_ANCHORS entry guards against a later trim. CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] and a new decisions entry D170 record the change as prose-only. fmt, clippy and the full workspace test all pass.

checks_run.note: 131 passed, including the new test and the FRAME_ANCHORS test
first run failed only on the system-facts line (computed reader size 1998 of 2000); fixed in docs/system-facts.md
first run wanted one assert! collapsed to one line in my new test; applied cargo fmt --all
whole workspace, run once after the final edits, exit 0 (includes the mirrors and xtask policy tests)

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-context/prompts/reader.md gains one rule in 'Reading the request': when a request says Athena or its agents should know, understand or act on something, the reading must state whether it means docs or agent behavior, name the roles and prompts that change, list the rules that bound those roles (ladder rungs, budgets, role limits, admission rules) and list as deliverables any blocking rule that is not owner-only. Verify with git diff.
criteria_check.evidence: Added one bullet under '## Reading the request': 'If Athena or agents should know or act on X: say docs or agent behavior; name the roles and prompts changed; list bounding rules (ladder rungs, budgets, role limits, admission); make blocking non-owner-only rules deliverables.' The only other change is shortening the first bullet by dropping the filler 'Users write lazily.'. Check with git diff -- crates/athena-context/prompts/reader.md.

criteria_check.criterion: A new unit test in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs asserts the composed reader prompt contains the docs-versus-agent-behavior rule and the rule-listing requirement. It fails on the pre-change reader.md and passes after. Run: cargo test -p athena-context.
criteria_check.evidence: Added the_reader_must_say_docs_or_agent_behavior_and_list_bounding_rules. It composes CONTRACT + READER_FRAME, slices '## Reading the request' to '## Forecasts', and asserts 'docs or agent behavior', 'roles and prompts', 'ladder rungs', 'budgets', 'role limits', 'admission' and 'blocking non-owner-only rules'. Also added the FRAME_ANCHORS entry ('reader','docs or agent behavior'). cargo test -p athena-context: 131 passed. The pre-change reader.md has none of these phrases (the old file text read in full), so the test would fail there; I did not run it against the base.

criteria_check.criterion: The budget check in crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs still passes: the reader set stays at or under 2000 tokens (71 left), so the producer must trim existing reader.md words if needed. Run: cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets.
criteria_check.evidence: The budgets test reported the computed reader size as 1998 of 2000. I set docs/system-facts.md '- budget reader:' to 1998 of 2000, and the full cargo test --locked then passed (budgets test included).

Their candidates' README.md, CHANGELOG.md and steward changes are dropped, so the verifier can check the prior findings do not recur in the diff.
criteria_check.evidence: A new first bullet under [Unreleased] > Changed names the root cause ("Athena knows X" is ambiguous between documentation for readers and behavior built into the agents; nothing made the reader ask which or list the bounding rules), says the fix is in the reader prompt and not in the two jobs, and marks the change prose-only. git status shows only five files changed: no README.md, steward or roles files.

criteria_check.criterion: Mirror and policy checks pass for the prompt edit: cargo test (whole workspace), including athena-core mirrors tests and the xtask policy test, plus cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy, all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran cargo fmt --all --check (clean after cargo fmt), cargo test --locked (exit 0, run once) and cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings (clean). D170 was appended after D169 with a Provenance bullet.

criteria_check.criterion: No new refusal rule is added; the change is prose-only, marked as such in CHANGELOG.md. It does not edit defaults.toml, athena.toml or workflows, which Athena changes only via its proposal path, so no past readings are newly refused (expected 0% of newly refused readings).
criteria_check.evidence: The CHANGELOG bullet says 'Prose-only: no refusal rule, check, governance file or budget changes.' git status --short lists only CHANGELOG.md, reader.md, athena-context/src/lib.rs, docs/decisions.md and docs/system-facts.md. No defaults.toml, athena.toml or workflow file changed.

open_issues: docs/system-facts.md is not a listed deliverable. I changed one number (the reader budget line) because the budgets tests compare it with the computed size. The plan names this edit.
The prose rule is not checked against model behavior. The test checks the text the reader receives, not what the reader writes.
I did not run the new test against the base reader.md. It fails there because the phrases are absent from the old file.
mistakes: My first version of the new test's assert! was not rustfmt-formatted; cargo fmt --all fixed it.
learnings: The reader set is composed from contract, READER_FRAME, defaults and catalog; the new bullet plus the trim brings it to 1998 of 2000 tokens, so 2 tokens of headroom remain.
docs/system-facts.md carries the exact reader size, and system_facts_budgets_match_computed and system_facts_drift_is_rejected fail until it is updated.
The Bash hook rejects pipes, redirects, command substitution, grep and tail for the producer role; run one plain cargo command at a time.
desires: A way to read a saved test log in the working directory, or a quiet cargo test mode that prints only the summary; the full output was too large to read and I relied on the exit status.
